load_character_metric: load the character metric using evaluate.load("character") for machine translation evaluation
launch_gradio_widget: launch a gradio widget for the character metric to interactively score predictions against references
compute_cer_scores: compute character-level edit rate scores for predictions against reference translations
compute_cer_with_aggregation: compute cer scores with aggregate options like mean, sum, or median across all items
compute_cer_with_multiple_references: compute cer scores with multiple references per prediction returning the best score
